title: Catastrophic Inflation in the Axiverse
summary: In the landscape of compactifications of type IIB string theory on O3/O7 orientifolds of Calabi--Yau threefolds, we identify regions of the axion potential in specific geometries that support small-field inflation, under the assumption that the overall Calabi--Yau volume can be stabilized at certain tuned values. At the tuned volume multiple critical points of the axion potential merge in a ``catastrophe'', creating a region with small gradient and small Hessian determinant --- necessary conditions for slow-roll inflation.
